> 第1921章 凌敏（第1页）
处理完虎夔城的后续管理事情之后，陈大人跟詹台老爷子这才发现不远处的角落中的白裙女子。
他们略微感应，就发现白裙女子的修为居然被禁锢，而且体内似乎有着极其邪恶的力量。
此言一出，陈大人跟詹台老爷子瞪大眼睛，一脸不可思议。
秦易将血源大人抓走了巴林家族的公主，想要送给血魔会长，以换取血魔会长跟他们玄冥血族的里应外合，彻底瓦解虎夔城。
陈大人皱眉，“巴林家族何其强大，玄冥血族居然敢抓巴林家族的公主，简直就是找死。”
“那接下来我们怎么办？”詹台老爷子问道。
白裙女子脸色苍白，她不断的摇头哀求，希望秦易能放她离开。
虎夔城一如既往的平静，谁也不知道昨夜虎夔城的四个城门之处，到底发生了什么事情。
一则重磅消息，迅速的传遍整个虎夔城。
发布声明之人，是闲将军跟陈大人以及詹台老爷子。
声明中称，虎夔城主被玄冥血族暗杀，导致陨落，虎夔城不能一日无主。
经过他们商议之后决定，让陈大人跟詹台老爷子共同管理虎夔城，闲将军协助。
此消息一出，整个虎夔城，彻底震惊了。
而身在丁九十九号的秦易，却丝毫没有理会这些事情。
斩杀了血源大人，帮助击溃了玄冥血族，而他的修为，也已经提升到了造化境三重，初步拥有了自保之力。
秦易将胡鸣呼唤来，后者还在疑惑，为何秦易突然主动找自己。
当他进入院落，看到白裙女子之后，彻底懵逼了。
胡鸣瞪大眼睛，不可思议的盯着白裙女子。
在秦易的帮助下，白裙女子的的修为已经恢复，虽然体内还残留着一些玄冥血族的特殊血脉之力，可这对秦易来说，也不是什么难事。
愣神过后，胡鸣脸上露出了激动之意。
整个巴林家族都在排挤他，唯独敏姐从小到大都非常照顾他，而且敏姐也是巴林家族唯一的公主，虽然不是长房所生，可因为她天资卓越，容颜绝世，故而得到了家族内部很多高层的喜爱。
胡鸣下意识的认为，敏姐是来找他的。
敏姐真名叫巴林凌敏，不过一般情况下，大家都叫她凌敏。
“那你为何会在这里？”胡鸣很好奇。
秦易笑着说道：“胡鸣兄，这位巴林家族的公主，被玄冥血族绑架，我机缘巧合之下将她救下，你将她毫发无伤的带回巴林家族，应该能得到一些赏赐吧？”
胡鸣愣住了，他第一时间关心凌敏的情况。
“敏姐，你没事吧？有没有受伤？”
看到胡鸣的着急表情，凌敏撇了撇嘴，说道：“你这家伙，姐没白疼你，幸亏有秦先生仗义出手，我才得以毫发无伤的站在这里。”

> Chapter 1921 Ling Min (page 1)
After handling the follow-up management of Hukui City, Mr. Chen and Mr. Zhantai discovered the woman in a white dress in the corner not far away.
They sensed it briefly and discovered that the woman in the white dress had her cultivation level imprisoned, and that she seemed to have extremely evil power within her body.
As soon as these words came out, Mr. Chen and Mr. Zhan Tai opened their eyes wide, with expressions of disbelief on their faces.
Qin Yi kidnapped Lord Bloodyuan and took away the princess of the Balin family, intending to give it to the Blood Demon Guild Leader in exchange for the cooperation between the Blood Demon Guild Leader and their Xuanming Blood Clan, completely disintegrating Hukui City.
Master Chen frowned, "The Balin family is so powerful. The Xuanming clan dares to capture the princess of the Balin family. They are simply seeking death."
"Then what should we do next?" Mr. Zhantai asked.
The woman in the white dress was pale. She kept shaking her head and begging, hoping that Qin Yi would let her go.
Hukui City is as peaceful as ever. No one knows what happened at the four gates of Hukui City last night.
A piece of breaking news quickly spread throughout Hukui City.
The people who issued the statement were General Xian, Master Chen and Mr. Zhan Tai.
The statement stated that the lord of Hukui City was assassinated by the Xuanming Blood Clan and fell. Hukui City cannot be left without an owner for a day.
After their discussion, they decided to let Mr. Chen and Mr. Zhantai jointly manage Hukui City, with General Xian assisting.
As soon as this news came out, the entire Hukui City was completely shocked.
But Qin Yi, who was at No. 99 Ding, paid no attention to these things.
He killed Master Xue Yuan and helped defeat the Xuan Ming Blood Clan. His cultivation level has also been promoted to the third level of Creation Realm, and he has initially gained the power to protect himself.
Qin Yi called Hu Ming, who was still wondering why Qin Yi suddenly took the initiative to find him.
When he entered the courtyard and saw the woman in the white dress, he was completely confused.
Hu Ming's eyes widened and he stared at the woman in the white dress in disbelief.
With Qin Yi's help, the woman in the white dress has recovered her cultivation. Although there is still some special blood power of the Xuanming blood clan remaining in her body, this is not difficult for Qin Yi.
After being stunned, Hu Ming showed excitement on his face.
The entire Bahrain family is ostracizing him, but Sister Min has taken great care of him since childhood. Sister Min is also the only princess of the Bahrain family. Although she is not born to the eldest brother, she is loved by many senior officials in the family because of her outstanding talent and peerless appearance.
Hu Ming subconsciously thought that Sister Min was here to find him.
Sister Min's real name is Balin Lingmin, but usually everyone calls her Lingmin.
"Then why are you here?" Hu Ming was curious.
Qin Yi said with a smile: "Brother Hu Ming, this princess of the Bahrain family was kidnapped by the Xuanming Blood Clan. I rescued her by chance. If you bring her back to the Bahrain family unscathed, you should get some rewards, right?"
Hu Ming was stunned. He was immediately concerned about Ling Min's condition.
"Sister Min, are you okay? Are you injured?"
Seeing Hu Ming's anxious expression, Ling Min curled her lips and said, "You guy, I didn't hurt you in vain. Fortunately, Mr. Qin took action, so I can stand here unscathed."
